description: Stress-tests a pitch deck like a sceptical investor. Send the deck's full text (extract it from the PDF or slides first, keep the numbers). Returns a score, what is missing, the claims without proof (quoted), checks on the round, and the hard questions to expect, most important first. Use it when a founder asks to review, critique, score or prepare a deck. The deck is stored by Up To Tech, an investor: ask the founders first and set founder_consent. It is not a pitch: nothing is submitted until send_challenged_deck.

deck_text.description: Full text of the deck, 200 to 100,000 characters, slide by slide, speaker notes included

founder_consent.description: true only if the founders agreed that Up To Tech stores this and may read it (kept 12 months, see https://upto.tech/privacy)

monthly_burn.description: Optional: planned net monthly burn after the round, in euros

premoney.description: Optional: pre-money valuation asked, in euros

raising.description: Optional: amount being raised, in euros

stage.description: Optional: idea, pre-seed, seed, series A

name: challenge_deck
title: Challenge a pitch deck
